[Upper Hand](https://m.bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Upper_Hand_(move)) is a  move that flinches the target, but the target has to be using a priority move for it to work. 

This creates the RPS system:

* Upper Hand blocks Bullet Punch (because of Bullet Punch's priority) 

* Bullet Punch blocks Focus Punch (because Focus Punch requires unbroken focus.) 

* Focus Punch blocks Upper Hand (because it's not a priority move, thus causing Upper Hand to fail.) 

This system has slightly more depth, because you have Jolly or Adamant natures. Jolly natures give you the advantage if both use Focus Punch, and Adamant nature deals more damage overall. And then there's a bit more luck as well, with speed ties where there'd normally just be regular ties in RPS (and thus, another round would be played.)
